decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the product feed to focus on actual backpacks rather than camping accessories. My consideration set includes a variety of styles: a high-capacity budget hiking pack (SHENHU), a tactical assault pack (Seibertron), an insulated cooler backpack (Scothen), a heavy-duty waterproof dry bag (Piscifun), and a standard day pack (Explorer). I ultimately chose the Seibertron Falcon Hiking Backpack because it has the most significant social proof with nearly 3,000 reviews and a high 4.6-star rating. While more expensive than the SHENHU budget option, the tactical design and expansion capabilities offer the durability and versatility I am looking for in a multi-purpose outdoor pack.
